control.condition: Rollers decoupled from the drive on a 20 N/mm tread (below the band), same 8 g hit: passed the throat (lost forward)

brackets.input: 50 ms hit into the nip, main power off, 40 N/mm tread
0.5 s deceleration into the nip, main power off, 40 N/mm tread
tread stiffness per roller, rollers decoupled, 8 g hit

basis: The pipe climbs part of the tread squeeze and rolls back to its seat with no power on the nip. The stroke joins two poses of the solved free-piece trace and stays within the recorded deviation of it; the trace, its control and its half-timestep repeat are in field-trials.json.
